messages.content:
SYSTEM items:
[0] Teletext functionality will not be included in the remote because it is outdated.
[1] The corporate identity should be clear in the remote design, with the corporate logo placed on the top-left, aligned with the screen.
[2] The product will be designed to control only one device.
[3] Include an equaliser with treble and bass, a mono/stereo option for the sound output, and pitch control.

[0] Include an LCD screen and speech recognition.

[3] Exclude teletext under the new management requirements.
[4] Restrict the remote to television control, superseding the provisional television-and-video scope.
[5] Include the corporate logo and corporate colours in the remote's design.
[6] Place the LCD at the top and favor a top-position microphone, leaving detailed placement to the designer.
[7] Use LEDs under the buttons to show which controls are active in the current mode.
